qa_pairs.instruction: What user-related operations are supported by the SCIM SAP Cloud driver?
qa_pairs.output: The SCIM SAP Cloud driver supports the following user operations: adding a user (POST to https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Users), modifying a user (PUT to https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Users/<sapcloud-userid>), migrating users between Identity Manager and SAP Cloud, polling users from SAP Cloud (GET to https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Users), and querying a specific user’s synced attributes (GET to https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Users/<sapcloud-userid>).

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you add a user using the SCIM SAP Cloud driver?
qa_pairs.output: To add a user with the SCIM SAP Cloud driver, send a POST request to the SCIM endpoint https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Users. Include the user’s details (first name, last name, contact information, email ID, location, department, user name, and initial login password) in the request body as a JSON payload. Identity Manager will then synchronize the new user to SAP Cloud.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you modify an existing user with the SCIM SAP Cloud driver?
qa_pairs.output: To modify a user in SAP Cloud using the SCIM SAP Cloud driver, send a PUT request to https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Users/<sapcloud-userid>, replacing <sapcloud-userid> with the identifier of the user to be updated. Include the changed attributes (e.g., first name, last name, contact details, email ID) in the JSON request body. The driver will synchronize the updates to SAP Cloud. Note: a user can be disabled via this operation in cases of separation or termination.

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you poll all users from SAP Cloud to Identity Manager using the SCIM SAP Cloud driver?
qa_pairs.output: To poll users from SAP Cloud, issue a GET request to the SCIM endpoint https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Users. The SCIM SAP Cloud driver will retrieve the list of users and synchronize them into Identity Manager.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you query a specific user’s synced attributes via the SCIM SAP Cloud driver?
qa_pairs.output: To query a specific user's attributes, send a GET request to https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Users/<sapcloud-userid>, replacing <sapcloud-userid> with the target user’s SAP Cloud identifier. The SCIM SAP Cloud driver will return the synced attributes for that user. Complex JSON attributes cannot be queried using the dxcmd utility.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you add a group using the SCIM SAP Cloud driver?
qa_pairs.output: To add a group, send a POST request to https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Groups with the group definition (e.g., group name, description) in the JSON request body. The SCIM SAP Cloud driver will create the group in SAP Cloud and synchronize it with Identity Manager.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you add a member to a group with the SCIM SAP Cloud driver?
qa_pairs.output: To add a member to an existing group, issue a POST request to https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Groups/<sapcloud-groupid>, replacing <sapcloud-groupid> with the group’s SAP Cloud identifier. Include the member’s user identifier in the request body as a JSON payload. The SCIM SAP Cloud driver will add the member to the group.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you delete a group using the SCIM SAP Cloud driver?
qa_pairs.output: To delete a group, send a DELETE request to https://<tenant ID>.accounts.ondemand.com/service/scim/Groups/<sapcloud-groupid>, where <sapcloud-groupid> is the identifier of the group you wish to remove. The SCIM SAP Cloud driver will delete the group from SAP Cloud; any members are moved to another group as required.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the supported SCIM operations for users and groups in the SCIM SAP Cloud driver.
qa_pairs.output: The SCIM SAP Cloud driver enables Identity Manager to perform full provisioning lifecycle operations for both users and public groups. For users, it supports adding (POST), modifying (PUT), migrating, polling (GET), and querying (GET) via dedicated SCIM endpoints. For groups, it supports adding groups (POST), adding or removing members (POST), deleting groups (DELETE), migrating, polling (GET), and querying (GET) through respective SCIM endpoints. Complex JSON attributes cannot be queried using the dxcmd utility.
